interface.signature: def canFinish(n: int, prerequisites: List[List[int]]) -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of courses must be non-negative.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p[0] < n and 0 <= p[1] < n for p in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Each prerequisite pair must refer to valid course indices.

postconditions.description: It is possible to finish all courses if and only if there is no cycle in the prerequisite graph.
